shortDescription: Australia’s sensitive government data is kept in a “fortress,” Deputy Prime Minister Richard Marles said Sunday after revelations last week that an OpenAI model hacked a government website, according to Bloomberg.Marles sought to reassure the public following the disclosure.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Australia’s Deputy PM Defends Government Data Security After OpenAI Hack
